contract.purpose: Compute a week-start calendar date from DATEPART weekday arithmetic.
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: Explicit date bypasses warehouse conversion entirely. NULL warehouse uses UTC now only when date missing. Invalid/missing warehouse timezone can fail delegated conversion.
output_shape: datetime at midnight through a local DATE variable.

ordered_branches.explanation: Only when input date is NULL, obtain UTC now; if warehouse is non-NULL replace with warehouse-local current datetime.
Compute DATEADD(day,2-DATEPART(weekday,date),date), assign to DATE and return as datetime.

contract.status_and_quantity_effects: No persistent status, inventory quantity or permissions mutation; output is the stated scalar or returned table.
configuration_scope_and_precedence: DATEPART weekday depends on session DATEFIRST; body does not SET it. No universal Monday/Sunday/ISO week boundary is guaranteed by the method name.
error_and_return_handling: No explicit exception handler or application error code; conversion, arithmetic and called-function errors propagate.
contract.transaction_ownership: No explicit transaction, commit, rollback, savepoint, TRY/CATCH or XACT_ABORT is introduced by this body; caller/session semantics remain authoritative.
concurrency: No persistent mutation or lock protocol; reads, if any, follow caller/session isolation. Function result is not evidence of caller authorization or process execution.
contract.trigger_behavior: No persistent DML or DML trigger activation in this body.
external_handoffs_and_gaps: Warehouse/current-time and session DATEFIRST settings were not observed; no executed calendar examples.
